notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Additional Options have been added to control:
• Motion Blur (ON/OFF)
• Volumetric Fog (ON/OFF)
• invert the X/Y axis for mouse control
• invert the X/Y axis for gamepads
• adjust the sensitivity of the X/Y axis for mouse control 
• adjust the sensitivity of the X/Y axis for gamepads
